system.description: Prerequisites: Fortitude (2), Obfuscate (3). Spend one Blood Trait; for one hour, no damage the vampire suffers produces any visible sign (no wounds, limping, or bleeding) until the power ends, though existing damage still applies mechanically. Auspex users may pierce it with the standard Auspex-vs-Obfuscate challenge; bystanders may attempt a Mental Challenge if the lack of injury becomes implausible. Grants a two-Trait bonus on Social Tests about the character's physical state while active.
